fields.plant_name: ASPILSAN Kayseri lithium-ion cell plant (Mimarsinan Industrial Zone)

rows.notes: Discovery add (T044, Europe/Turkey sweep). Turkey's first Li-ion cell plant, Kayseri (Mimarsinan Industrial Zone per S08). Small: 220 MWh/yr = 0.22 GWh (~22 million 18650 cells/yr per invest.gov.tr S06; MarkLines S05/S07 'annual production capacity is 220 MWh'). Kept because it is a real commercial cell plant, but sub-0.5 GWh. Cylindrical per S05; cell chemistry (cells shown as INR18650A28 2,800 mAh and 21700) and end market (defence/aviation, civil) not stated on opened pages -> null. Status operational: MarkLines (visible text, 2022-12-08) says the company 'started mass production ... at its facility in Kayseri' (start_year 2022). Conflicts: invest.gov.tr page is dated 2022-09-13 yet describes mass production, MarkLines dates it 7 Dec 2022; battery-tech.net profile (undated, S08) says the facility was launched in 2024. start_year 2022 follows the two dated sources; ref_year 2022 = publication-year fallback, searched (no expansion with a GWh figure found; a Feb 2025 TUSAS aviation-cell localisation partnership per S08 gives no capacity). installed_capacity_gwh left null: the 220 MWh is a plant capacity figure, no dated installed figure. parent_company not stated on opened pages (ASPILSAN is understood to be an ASELSAN-group company but not confirmed) -> null. No 2025-26 production or output data found, so confidence 0.55. Coordinates not located (industrial-zone level only); left null. ASPILSAN's own site returned 503.

fields.plant_name: Pomega South Carolina LFP cell factory (Colleton Industrial Campus, near Walterboro)

rows.notes: Discovery add (T044, USA sweep). Kontrolmatik's US subsidiary Pomega: LFP cell plant for grid-scale storage in Colleton County, SC. Announced 8 Dec 2022 (S03: 3 GWh, USD 279m, operations expected 2024). Feb 2023 article (S01): 'hosted a groundbreaking ceremony'; production 'expected ... in mid-2024'; phase 1 3 GWh, 'plans to later increase capacity to 6 GWh' (S02). Phase breakdown: 3 GWh initial (planned) + 3 GWh later (planned, undated) -> nameplate 6 GWh per D-014, ref_year 2023 = publication-year fallback, searched (no phase dates in opened sources; an undated profile snippet seen only in search results, not opened, says phase 2 end-2025 and 6 GWh by 2027). Status stays announced (D-020): only a ceremonial groundbreaking is evidenced, no later site works found. Freshness: nothing dated after 2024 about this site found in the sources I could open; 2025-26 coverage (ONE offtake, May 2025) concerns Pomega's Ankara plant (existing row pomega-...-polatl-ankara-turkey), not South Carolina; the 2024 start target has evidently passed with no production report, so the project may be stalled - project_state left active (no source says paused/cancelled), confidence 0.35. An energy-storage.news piece on Pomega's US cell-production scepticism returned 403 and is not cited. Cell format not stated -> null. Coordinates not located (Colleton Industrial Campus, Walterboro area) -> null. Possible follow-up: SC Commerce / Colleton County records or Kontrolmatik KAP filings for current status.
